nhc2019_157.cross_check: gov.cn page carries the attachment table twice: both copies identical (324 rows). Compared row by row (编号, 省份, 类型, 名称) with the NHC original page https://www.nhc.gov.cn/yzygj/c100068/201902/39c01916f98a45c58418a839d82fda0c.shtml (saved from a browser, sha256 7d341edd249f477c80eaec2eadec95e631ce099ba3a3a4aacdefb79b72896333): 324/324 rows identical, so per-province and per-role counts agree. Parsed roles 1/32/291 equal the notice text '1家国家级牵头医院、32家省级牵头医院和291家协作网成员医院'.
nhc2019_157.note: 附件 第一批罕见病诊疗协作网医院名单 is inline on the page as an HTML table (编号/省份/类型/协作网医院). Dated 2019-02-12; NHC posted it 2019-02-15, gov.cn 政策库 2019-10-08. All 324 rows are parsed; only the hospitals whose name is absent from the 2024 list are rows of this file with this source_id. The others are carried by their 2024 row (no_2019 gives their 2019 编号, name_2019 the 2019 spelling when it differs).

nhc2024_64.title: 国家卫生健康委办公厅关于调整全国罕见病诊疗协作网成员医院和办公室人员的通知
nhc2024_64.issuer: 国家卫生健康委办公厅
nhc2024_64.cross_check: Parsed 419 rows, 编号 1..419 continuous. The notice and the docx state no total; the 419 total is stated by NHC itself (nhc_reply_2024_02403: '目前已有419家医院纳入协作网范围') and by the gov.cn news page (govcn_news_2024_419): parsed 419 = stated 419. No official per-role total exists for 2024; parsed roles are 1 national lead / 32 provincial lead / 386 member. No second official copy of the 2024 list was found (gov.cn 政策库 has no entry for this notice), so no row-level cross-check. The same docx bytes were obtained via the browser and via urllib (same sha256). Against 2019: 285 same name, 11 renamed on string evidence, 123 new names, 28 2019 names absent.
nhc2024_64.note: Dated 2024-02-28, posted by NHC 医政司 2024-03-18. 附件1 全国罕见病诊疗协作网成员医院名单 is the full adjusted list (it replaces the 2019 list; it does not mark what changed). sha256/bytes are of the docx, which nhc.gov.cn serves to scripts without the 412 challenge; the notice page itself was read in a browser (rendered DOM sha256 98664e609f0b7db6808781a9d5f8f9d022a8e264443b69192520cce726acf2a9). 附件2 (协作网办公室人员名单) is not used. Two 西藏 rows are typed 成员单位 instead of 成员医院; role=member, role_zh as published.

provenance.coverage: Hospitals of the national 全国罕见病诊疗协作网 as published by the National Health Commission: the first list (国卫办医函〔2019〕157号, 324 hospitals) and the adjusted full list that replaced it (国卫办医政函〔2024〕64号 附件1, 419 hospitals: 1 national lead, 32 provincial lead, 386 member). Current membership = the 419 rows with source_id nhc2024_64; rows with source_id nhc2019_157 are 2019 names absent from the 2024 list. As of 2026-10-06 the 2024 list is the only later official membership revision found; the 2023 第二批罕见病目录 notice carries a disease list only, and 国卫办医政函〔2026〕305号 (2026-09-14) asks for 有条件的中医医院 to be added but names none. Searched: gov.cn 政策库 API (sousuo.www.gov.cn/search-gov/data, t=zhengcelibrary_bm and zhengcelibrary, q=罕见病诊疗协作网 and q=调整全国罕见病诊疗协作网成员医院); NHC 医政司 政策文件 list (300 most recent documents, 2021-06-28..2026-09-20), titles with 罕见/协作网: 2026-09-20 关于进一步加强罕见病防治工作的通知; 2025-07-10 国家卫生健康委办公厅关于印发软骨发育不全等86个罕见病病种诊疗指南(2025年版)的通知; 2024-03-18 国家卫生健康委办公厅关于调整全国罕见病诊疗协作网成员医院和办公室人员的通知; 2023-09-20 关于公布第二批罕见病目录的通知; 2022-12-27 国家卫生健康委办公厅关于印发国家罕见病医学中心设置标准的通知; web search (exa, WebSearch) for 罕见病诊疗协作网 成员医院 调整/增补/新增 2020-2026 and for reposts of 国卫办医政函〔2024〕64号. NOT covered: provincial or city-level rare-disease networks, 罕见病门诊 designations required by the 2026 notice, 国家罕见病医学中心, which diseases or departments each hospital covers, addresses or contacts, Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan (none are listed), and any membership change NHC made after the 2024 list without publishing a list. A 2019 name counts as renamed only on string evidence inside the two lists; a hospital that changed its name beyond that (for example a medical school upgraded to a university) appears as removed_2024 plus added_2024, so removed_2024 means 'this 2019 name is not in the 2024 list', not proof the hospital left the network.
